memo.Description: The Board will call the meeting to order and establish a quorum by roll call.

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: Welcome by the School Board President.
The School Board will review and discuss any requested additions, deletions, or modifications to the agenda prior to its adoption.

items.title: 4. Approval of the Agenda (Action Required) - 1 min

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: Motion to approve the agenda as submitted or amended.

Public Comment : The Board will limit comments to items on the agenda and will be accepted in person only. Speaker cards are available at the entrance and can be submitted to the secretary before the meeting begins, or you may raise your hand during the meeting to indicate your desire to speak. Speakers will be called when the agenda item is considered. Comments are limited to 3 minutes per speaker per topic, unless otherwise noted.

items.title: 1. Governing Board Workshop with California School Boards Association Consultant

memo.Quick Summary / Abstract: The Redwood City School District Governance Team will participate in the Governing Board Workshop, a professional development session designed to foster trust and enhance governance team effectiveness. The workshop will focus on building stronger relationships through understanding roles, responsibilities, and the four elements of teamwork: collaboration, communication, commitment, and celebration. The School Board will also discuss its self-evaluation and priorities. This session is especially valuable for strengthening team cohesion.
memo.Financial Impact: No financial impact to the district.
